settings.question: What is the Return Policy for Factory Seconds cookware?
settings.answer: All Factory Seconds sales are final.  We will not accept returns or exchanges on any pieces purchased during the Seconds Sale.

settings.question: Can I use other discounts or promo codes on Factory Seconds pieces?
settings.answer: No, additional discounts cannot be applied to Factory Seconds, as these items are already specially priced for the sale.

settings.question: Can I have my Factory Seconds pieces engraved?
settings.answer: Yes, Factory Seconds pieces can be engraved.
